title: Odd-indexed tail sum identity
statement: For every odd natural number $k$, the sum of the limiting majority Fourier weights from index $k+1$ onward equals the sum over the indices $k+2(r+1)$ for $r\in\mathbb{N}$; that is, $\sum_{r=0}^{\infty} w_{k+1+r}=\sum_{r=0}^{\infty} w_{k+2(r+1)}$, where $w_j$ denotes the limiting majority Fourier weight at index $j$.
